title: Tour: Calendar view
blurb: See every booking for you and your team by day, week or month.

steps.title: Open Calendar view
steps.body: Click **Calendar view** along the top. This is your team diary.

steps.title: Move around the diary
steps.body: Switch between **Day**, **Week** and **Month**, and click **Today** to jump back to now. The small month picker lets you leap to any date.

steps.title: Choose whose diary you see
steps.body: The filter panel on the right lets you tick which **Users** and **Calendars** show. Untick people to declutter a busy week.
steps.tip: Short on screen space? Use **Manage View** to hide the panel.

steps.title: Open any booking
steps.body: Click an appointment to see the customer, change its status, or move it to another time.

steps.title: Add a booking by hand
steps.body: Click an empty time slot to book someone in yourself, for example when a customer rings up.

steps.title: Next step
steps.body: Next: try **Book an appointment by hand** from the Guide.
